categories.name: Google Maps presence
categories.question: Can nearby customers find an accurate, complete profile when they search on Google Maps?
categories.limitations: Local results vary by searcher location, device and time. Sampled positions are observations, not rankings. Private profile data (e.g. Insights) is only available with the owner’s delegated access.

criteria.label: Profile found and matches the business
criteria.measure: A Google Business Profile exists for the business name, phone and area.

tiers.0: No profile found after a documented search using name, phone and address variants
tiers.1: Found; name, phone and area match
tiers.0.5: Found, but details conflict or an apparent duplicate exists

criteria.evidence: Profile URL, search queries used, date checked
criteria.missingData: If this cannot be checked (page or profile unavailable, access restricted, search not completed) mark Not verified. Do not score 0.
criteria.limitations: "Not found" is an observation only after the documented search; it is never assumed.

criteria.label: Primary category and services fit
criteria.measure: Primary category matches the core service; services are listed.

tiers.1: Primary category correct and services listed
tiers.0.5: Category acceptable but services missing, or category too broad

criteria.evidence: Screenshot or noted category + services, date
criteria.missingData: If this cannot be checked (page or profile unavailable, access restricted, search not completed) mark Not verified. Do not score 0.
criteria.limitations: Secondary categories are not always publicly visible.

criteria.label: Profile completeness
criteria.measure: Count of: hours, website link, phone, address/service area, business description.
criteria.evidence: Checklist of the five fields with date
criteria.missingData: If this cannot be checked (page or profile unavailable, access restricted, search not completed) mark Not verified. Do not score 0.
criteria.limitations: Descriptions are hidden in some views; check the full profile.

criteria.label: Recent photos or updates
criteria.measure: Owner-added photos or updates visible within the last 90 days.
criteria.evidence: Date of most recent owner photo/update
criteria.missingData: If this cannot be checked (page or profile unavailable, access restricted, search not completed) mark Not verified. Do not score 0.
criteria.limitations: Photo dates are approximate in the public interface.

criteria.label: Visible in sampled local results
criteria.measure: Position in local results for "<core service> <city>" in a sampled search with recorded conditions.
sources: Approved search API or manual sample with recorded location, device, date
criteria.evidence: Query, location, device, date, observed position
criteria.missingData: If this cannot be checked (page or profile unavailable, access restricted, search not completed) mark Not verified. Do not score 0.
criteria.limitations: One sample from one location. Positions change by searcher location and over time.

categories.name: AI discovery readiness
categories.question: Is the information AI assistants rely on consistent, structured and worth citing?
categories.limitations: AI assistant answers vary by assistant, version, date, location and conversation context. Results are observations under recorded conditions and never a stable ranking.

criteria.label: Business facts consistent across sources
criteria.measure: Name, address/service area and phone match across website, Google profile and the top 3 directories for the industry.
criteria.evidence: Table of values per source with URLs and date
criteria.missingData: If this cannot be checked (page or profile unavailable, access restricted, search not completed) mark Not verified. Do not score 0.
criteria.limitations: Directory choice is industry-specific and recorded with the result.

criteria.label: Local business structured data
criteria.measure: Valid LocalBusiness (or subtype) structured data with name, phone and area on the website.

tiers.0.5: Present with errors or missing key fields

criteria.evidence: Validator result/screenshot and date
criteria.missingData: If this cannot be checked (page or profile unavailable, access restricted, search not completed) mark Not verified. Do not score 0.
criteria.limitations: Structured data supports understanding; it does not guarantee use by any AI system.

criteria.label: Answer-focused service content
criteria.measure: Service pages directly answer common customer questions (what’s included, process, pricing factors, area served).
criteria.evidence: URLs reviewed and notes, date
criteria.missingData: If this cannot be checked (page or profile unavailable, access restricted, search not completed) mark Not verified. Do not score 0.
criteria.limitations: Qualitative review against a written checklist.

criteria.label: Reputable third-party mentions
criteria.measure: Business appears on reputable third-party sources (associations, local media, quality directories).
sources: Public web search via approved service
criteria.evidence: Source URLs and date
criteria.missingData: If this cannot be checked (page or profile unavailable, access restricted, search not completed) mark Not verified. Do not score 0.
criteria.limitations: Coverage of search tools is incomplete; absence is "none found", not "none exist".

criteria.label: Mentioned in sampled AI answers
criteria.measure: Across a recorded prompt set on named assistants, the business is mentioned and described accurately.

tiers.0: Not mentioned in any sampled prompt
tiers.1: Mentioned accurately in at least half of prompts
tiers.0.5: Mentioned in some prompts or with inaccuracies

sources: Named AI assistants, used within their terms
criteria.evidence: Prompt text, assistant + version if shown, date, location context, raw answers saved
criteria.missingData: If this cannot be checked (page or profile unavailable, access restricted, search not completed) mark Not verified. Do not score 0.
criteria.limitations: High variability. Repeat with identical conditions before comparing months.

categories.name: Reviews & trust
categories.question: When customers compare you, does your reputation make you the obvious choice?
categories.limitations: Only public review data is used. Competitor set (3–5 nearby, same category) is recorded with the result.

criteria.label: Review volume vs. local competitors
criteria.measure: Google review count compared with the median of 3–5 nearby competitors.
criteria.evidence: Counts for business and named competitors, date
criteria.missingData: If this cannot be checked (page or profile unavailable, access restricted, search not completed) mark Not verified. Do not score 0.
criteria.limitations: Volume is relative to the recorded competitor set only.

criteria.label: Average rating
criteria.measure: Google average star rating.
criteria.evidence: Rating and count, date
criteria.missingData: If this cannot be checked (page or profile unavailable, access restricted, search not completed) mark Not verified. Do not score 0.
criteria.limitations: Ratings with very few reviews are low-information; note count.

criteria.label: Review recency
criteria.measure: Age of the most recent Google review.
criteria.evidence: Date of latest review
criteria.missingData: If this cannot be checked (page or profile unavailable, access restricted, search not completed) mark Not verified. Do not score 0.
criteria.limitations: Public dates can be relative ("2 weeks ago").

criteria.label: Owner responses
criteria.measure: Share of the 10 most recent reviews with an owner response.
criteria.evidence: Count of responses in last 10, date
criteria.missingData: If this cannot be checked (page or profile unavailable, access restricted, search not completed) mark Not verified. Do not score 0.
criteria.limitations: Fewer than 10 reviews: use all available and note it.

criteria.label: Trust proof on website
criteria.measure: Count of: licence/insurance info where applicable, real team or job photos, stated warranty/guarantee terms, link to public reviews.
criteria.evidence: URLs and checklist, date
criteria.missingData: If this cannot be checked (page or profile unavailable, access restricted, search not completed) mark Not verified. Do not score 0.
criteria.limitations: Photo authenticity is judged visually; stock photos do not count.

categories.name: Website conversion
categories.question: Does the website make it easy to understand, trust and contact you, especially on a phone?
categories.limitations: We observe the site as a visitor would and never submit fake inquiries. Speed uses lab data, which differs from real-user data.

criteria.label: Call/CTA visible on mobile
criteria.measure: On a ~390px-wide screen, tap-to-call or the primary CTA is visible without scrolling.

tiers.0: No phone/CTA found on the homepage
tiers.0.5: Present but below the fold or not tappable

criteria.evidence: Mobile screenshot, date
criteria.missingData: If this cannot be checked (page or profile unavailable, access restricted, search not completed) mark Not verified. Do not score 0.
criteria.limitations: Homepage only unless noted.

criteria.label: Clear offer above the fold
criteria.measure: First screen states the service, the area served and a reason to choose them.
criteria.evidence: Screenshot + checklist, date
criteria.missingData: If this cannot be checked (page or profile unavailable, access restricted, search not completed) mark Not verified. Do not score 0.
criteria.limitations: Judged against the written checklist.

criteria.label: Mobile page speed
criteria.measure: Google PageSpeed Insights mobile performance score for the homepage.
criteria.evidence: Score, report URL or JSON, date
criteria.missingData: If this cannot be checked (page or profile unavailable, access restricted, search not completed) mark Not verified. Do not score 0.
criteria.limitations: Lab score; varies run to run (take the median of 3 runs).

criteria.label: Low-friction inquiry form
criteria.measure: A quote/contact form exists, needs 5 or fewer required fields and is usable on mobile.

tiers.0.5: Exists but long or awkward on mobile

criteria.evidence: Form URL, field count, date (not submitted)
criteria.missingData: If this cannot be checked (page or profile unavailable, access restricted, search not completed) mark Not verified. Do not score 0.
criteria.limitations: Forms are inspected, never submitted with fake data.

criteria.label: Technical basics
criteria.measure: Valid HTTPS, no security warnings, primary navigation links work.
criteria.evidence: Checklist, date
criteria.missingData: If this cannot be checked (page or profile unavailable, access restricted, search not completed) mark Not verified. Do not score 0.
criteria.limitations: Spot check, not a full crawl.

categories.name: Lead follow-up
categories.question: When someone reaches out, how reliably do they hear back and get booked?
categories.limitations: Internal follow-up processes are usually not public. They are Not verified unless the owner reports them or authorises a test. We never send fake inquiries.

criteria.label: Ways to reach the business
criteria.measure: Count of public inquiry paths: phone, form, text/SMS, online booking.
criteria.evidence: Checklist with URLs, date
criteria.missingData: If this cannot be checked (page or profile unavailable, access restricted, search not completed) mark Not verified. Do not score 0.
criteria.limitations: Counts visible paths only.

criteria.label: After-hours capture
criteria.measure: A visible way to start an inquiry outside business hours (booking, form with response promise, chat).

tiers.1: Clear after-hours option with response expectation

criteria.evidence: Screenshot/notes, date
criteria.missingData: If this cannot be checked (page or profile unavailable, access restricted, search not completed) mark Not verified. Do not score 0.
criteria.limitations: Does not test whether anyone responds.

criteria.label: Online booking or quote request
criteria.measure: Customers can book or request a quote online.
criteria.evidence: URL, date
criteria.missingData: If this cannot be checked (page or profile unavailable, access restricted, search not completed) mark Not verified. Do not score 0.
criteria.limitations: Not submitted.

criteria.label: Speed to first response
criteria.measure: Typical time to first response for a new inquiry.
criteria.evidence: Owner answer with date, or authorised test log
criteria.missingData: Not publicly observable. Mark Not verified unless owner-reported or tested with written authorisation. Never assume a slow response.
criteria.limitations: Owner reports are not independently verified.

ownerQuestion.prompt: How fast do you usually respond to a new inquiry?

criteria.label: Missed-call recovery
criteria.measure: What happens after a missed call.

tiers.1: Text or call back within 15 minutes

criteria.evidence: Owner answer with date, or authorised test log
criteria.missingData: Not publicly observable. Mark Not verified unless owner-reported or tested with written authorisation.
criteria.limitations: Owner reports are not independently verified.

ownerQuestion.prompt: What happens when you miss a call?

options.label: We text or call back within 15 min
We call back the same day

criteria.label: Quote follow-up
criteria.measure: Unaccepted quotes receive structured follow-up.

tiers.0: Only if the customer calls back

criteria.evidence: Owner answer with date
criteria.missingData: Not publicly observable. Mark Not verified unless owner-reported.
criteria.limitations: Owner reports are not independently verified.

ownerQuestion.prompt: Do you follow up on quotes that haven’t been accepted?

options.label: Yes, on a set schedule (2+ touches)
